```sql
SELECT s.Zip
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = '1';
```

```sql
SELECT s.Zip
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.District = 'Fresno County Office of Education'
AND f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = '1';
```

```sql
SELECT s.Zip 
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 'Yes' AND s.District = 'Fresno County Office of Education';
```
